gem_empathy.definition: Reading what another person feels, and taking it seriously enough to act on it.
gem_empathy.example: Her empathy showed in the question she asked instead of the advice she gave.

kpar_recall.definition: The ability to bring a fact back into the mind when it is needed, without looking it up.
kpar_recall.example: My recall of the formula is good; my recall of the reason behind it is not.

litre.definition: A measure of liquid. There are 1000 millilitres in one litre.
litre.example: I drink one litre of milk every week.

psy_manipulation.definition: The use of pressure, ambiguity or emotion to move a person into a decision that does not serve them, without giving a real choice.
psy_manipulation.example: It was manipulation: he offered her two options and made the wrong one impossible.

variable.definition: A symbol, often x, whose value is found by solving.
variable.example: Let x be the unknown variable.

wh_trip.definition: To open the circuit by itself, because the device has found a fault or an overload.
wh_trip.example: The RCD tripped when the heater was switched on.
